caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden clock with a rectangular frame featuring a reddish-brown grain and decorative accents in black and gold. The clock face is circular with black Arabic numerals and black hands, surrounded by a square border with a floral design in red, green, and yellow. Above the clock face is a curved black section with a gold decorative motif. The clock has two black columns, one on each side, both adorned with gold detailing at the top and bottom. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular glass panel showing the painted image of a woman in a pink dress with puffed sleeves, a large yellow hat with a bow, and a green sash. The background of the drawing is a neutral, off-white color with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Clock
